newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Value of NZ building work rose 2.1 pct in June qtr.
newsitem.headline: Value of NZ building work rose 2.1 pct in June qtr.

text.p: Statistics for the June 1996 quarter indicated the level of New Zealand building work was continuing to rise, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
"The trend estimate for building work put in place increased 2.1 percent from the March 1996 quarter to the June 1996 quarter," SNZ said.

"Strong growth in the trend since late 1992 has slowed in the last year. Growth in the last four quarters has averaged 1.5 percent per quarter. This follows growth averaging 5.7 percent per quarter for the three years leading up to June 1995."
